typography.strategy: Soft Utility (Dashboard/Apps) adapted for fast data comprehension

headings.styling: tracking-tight, never center-aligned by default. H1 cap at text-4xl for dashboard utility.

body.styling: Tabular numerals for all tables and inventory metrics (tabular-nums).

primary.name: Burnt Apricot / Chef's Orange
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, key highlights. Limit usage to avoid visual fatigue.

background.rule: White/light background prioritized. NEVER use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.

layouts.strategy: Functional beauty, dense but touch-friendly for tablets.
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Large touch targets (min h-12) for all buttons and inputs to accommodate kitchen staff on tablets.
layouts.navigation: Role-based sidebar navigation. Fixed left side. Must be collapsible but always accessible. Grouped sections with clean icons.
layouts.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border (border-border), no massive drop shadows. Use subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl).
layouts.tables: Data-dense but readable. Use Shadcn Table. MUST have horizontal scrolling for mobile/tablet. Sticky headers. Use alternating row colors or distinct border-b for separation.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, dense content. Right-align numeric columns in tables (variance, stock, cost).

grids.kpi_cards: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 (Today's Sales, MTD Sales, Inv Value, Food Cost %, Wastage, Variance).
grids.charts: col-span-full lg:col-span-3 (Sales Trend vs Food Cost).
rules: Grid items must be direct children
Use align-self: stretch to match heights

component_instructions.buttons: Large touch targets. min-h-[3rem] (h-12). Pill-shaped or soft-rounded (rounded-lg).
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Stacked labels (above inputs). Left-aligned. Clear validation states.
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn). Keep them simple: Line for trends, Bar for brand-wise sales. Accessible color palettes.
component_instructions.workflows: Multi-step workflows (Procurement -> Approval) should use a clear Wizard/Stepper UI at the top.
component_instructions.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Clean, stroke-based. No emojis for icons.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='post-sales-btn').

motion.strategy: Minimal & Functional. NO unnecessary bouncy animations.
allowed: Smooth layout transitions for expanding rows

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for standard text. Never gray-on-gray.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states on all inputs/buttons for keyboard navigation.

kitchen_chef_placeholder.description: Chef chopping vegetables, good for recipe or R&D trial placeholder headers.

kitchen_prep.description: Chef preparing foods. Suitable for dashboard hero or store inventory empty states.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this dashboard feel like a high-end, tactile kitchen tool.
NEVER use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid, flat backgrounds.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like background-color or transform.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components. Customize them for large touch targets (tablets in kitchens).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis 🤖🧠 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Data tables MUST be highly legible. Use tabular-nums for numeric columns.
Ensure stock status colors (Green, Yellow, Red) have sufficient contrast. Use the exact background/text pairings provided in the colors section.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (e.g., 'Invoice Uploaded', 'Sales Posted').
